summary: Frontend regression test of client-side error noise-filter fix (errorReporter.js NOISE_PATTERNS + ErrorBoundary chunk skip). All 7 requested checks PASS. Noise events (Script error, _AutofillCallbackHandler, Loading chunk 9999 failed) fire 0 POSTs to /api/errors/report. Real runtime error + user-driven bug report both land in Supabase error_reports as expected. Previously-resolved noise signatures still have resolved_at NOT NULL and regressed_at NULL (no regressions). ErrorBoundary render path grep-verified for error-boundary-report-desc + error-boundary-report-submit testids.

issues: The webpack/react dev-mode 'Uncaught runtime errors' full-screen overlay activates for any window.error event and covers the entire UI including the BugReportButton and interactive controls until dismissed. This is dev-only (CRA error-overlay) and does not affect production users, but during any preview-env QA that dispatches synthetic errors it blocks subsequent interactions unless dismissed with the top-right X. Not a fix request — informational only.

critical_code_review_comments: errorReporter.js NOISE_PATTERNS list is tight and correct (covers Script error., _AutofillCallbackHandler, ResizeObserver, chunk/CSS-chunk/dynamic-import load failures). Extension-origin stacks filtered via chrome/moz/safari-extension: check on stack. user_description bypass correctly gated on !user_description in both isNoise and throttle branches — user reports still land.
ErrorBoundary.componentDidCatch correctly skips reportError when isChunkLoadError(error) is true; still self-heals with one-shot sessionStorage-flagged hard reload. LGTM.
seed_data_creation: Two new rows inserted in Supabase error_reports as part of positive regression tests: (a) signature TestingAgent_verification:_this_is_a_rea_gqsids error_type=runtime, (b) signature [user_report]_testing-agent_verification_nvncao error_type=user_report. Main agent may want to auto-resolve these two testing-agent-created rows before shipping to keep the admin errors tab clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The noise-filter fix (errorReporter.js NOISE_PATTERNS + ErrorBoundary chunk skip) is verified working on preview URL https://mock-exam-mvp.preview.emergentagent.com. When dispatching synthetic ErrorEvents in the browser console to test, note that the CRA/webpack dev-mode error overlay will activate and cover the UI — it must be dismissed (top-right X) before further UI interactions. Positive regression proof: 0 rows in error_reports last 10min matching '%chunk%|%Script error%|%AutofillCallback%'. The two auto-resolved noise signatures (Script_error._c3k3oq, ReferenceError:_Can't_find_variable:__Au_sdgwfc) remain with resolved_at set and regressed_at NULL.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration was verification only, not a bug hunt. The 6 stale rows were pre-resolved by main agent; the client-side NOISE_PATTERNS filter prevents new occurrences from re-inserting or regressing those signatures. User-driven reports and real runtime errors still flow through unchanged.
